description: Verateca Table is a searchable reference for ingredients used in dietary supplements. It has a short view of 111 commonly used ingredients and a full view of 312 ingredients in nine groups. Users can search by name, symbol or entry number and filter by ingredient group. Ingredient profiles cite sources for supplement forms, safety information and interactions. Version 1.0 of the dataset includes both editions in CSV and JSON.
name: Verateca Table
